description: Save the industry profile you researched during setup. Send the whole profile each time: it replaces the saved one. Needs a saved brand.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

profile.description: The whole profile. Send every part each time: it replaces the saved one.

wants.description: Required. What they want when they come looking, up to 240 characters.

who.description: Required. A kind of buyer, up to 160 characters.

buyers.description: Who buys: each kind of buyer and what they want when they come looking. Up to 6.

where.description: Where it sits in a piece, up to 200 characters.

callToAction.description: The one offer that turns a reader into a customer, and where it sits in a piece.

topic.description: Required. The theme, up to 120 characters.

why.description: Required. Why it moves a reader to act, up to 240 characters.

convertingTopics.description: 3 to 8 themes that move a reader to call, book or buy, and why each does.

entities.description: The names a piece should use the same way every time: the business, places, products, tools, brands. Up to 30, each up to 80 characters.

banned.description: What makes a piece filler, up to 10, each up to 200 characters.

required.description: What every piece must contain, up to 10, each up to 200 characters.

guardrails.description: What makes a piece filler in this trade, and what every piece must contain to be worth reading.

keywords.description: The search phrases to be found for. Only ones you saw demand for; say in `landscape.gap` when you could not check. Up to 40, each up to 80 characters.

gap.description: The gap this business can fill, up to 500 characters.

ranks.description: Who or what ranks today, and for which question, up to 10, each up to 200 characters.

landscape.description: What currently ranks or gets quoted for those questions, and the gap this business can fill.

localAngle.description: What is local: neighbourhoods, languages, seasons, rules. Empty for a business that sells everywhere. Up to 10, each up to 200 characters.

buying.description: Questions from people ready to book or buy, up to 15, each up to 160 characters.

comparing.description: Questions from people weighing options, up to 15, each up to 160 characters.

learning.description: Questions from people finding out, up to 15, each up to 160 characters.

nearby.description: Questions that name a place, up to 15, each up to 160 characters.

questions.description: The real questions buyers type, in their own words, grouped by what they are after. Take them from search suggestions, "people also ask", reviews and the customer.

for.description: Required. What it backs, up to 200 characters.

name.description: Required. The reference, up to 120 characters.

sources.description: The authoritative references a claim in this trade should be backed by. Up to 20.

tone.description: How writing for this trade should sound to land with its buyers, within brand.voice. Up to 400 characters.

definition.description: Required. The trade in one or two sentences, up to 300 characters.

segments.description: The kinds of customer or business within it, up to 8, each up to 160 characters.

trade.description: Required. What this trade is in one line, and the kinds of customer or business within it that behave differently.

name: profile_save
title: Save the industry profile
